question:
Select the appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

The police have not yet been able to solve the case; it seems to be __________________.
solution:
The correct answer is "**a hard nut to crack**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us start with understanding the meaning of the given idioms:
 
 
• "In a nutshell" means summarizing something in a brief manner.
 
 
• Example: In a nutshell, she thought she knew the best.
 
 
 
• "Turning over a new leaf" means starting anew or making a fresh start.
 
 
• Example: Apparently, she has stopped gossiping and promises to turn over a new leaf this year.
 
 
 
• **"A hard nut to crack" is an idiom that means a problem that is difficult to solve**.
 
 
• Example: The problem is a hard nut to crack.
 
 
 
• "In a pink" means to be in good health or in a good condition.
 
 
• ​Example: I met her and she seems to be in a pink.
 
 
 
 
 
• In this context, the police have been unable to solve the case, suggesting that it is a difficult problem to solve.
 
• Thus, the correct idiom to use is "a hard nut to crack."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.
